originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire summer_sign XZ AABB

compiledWorldPlacement.limits: one fixed authored summer_sign pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;10 finite rays on two flat stone bases,63 finite walkability samples and conservative envelope clearances. Not a continuous placement/stability/physical/body or all-camera-visibility guarantee

compiledWorldScope: Actual current Scene meshes and original-Sprite future-visible envelopes with document=null; baseline after normal tree-road correction. Browser original-image decode, actual art-ready world and native visibility are separate gates.
